tEn: NVIDIA Nemotron Nano 2: An Accurate and Efficient Hybrid Mamba-Transformer Reasoning Model
tZh: NVIDIA Nemotron Nano 2：一种准确高效、基于Mamba-Transformer混合架构的推理模型
sEn: Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2 matches or surpasses similarly-sized models in accuracy and achieves up to 6x higher inference throughput for reasoning.
sZh: Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2在准确性上与同类模型相当或更优，同时推理吞吐量提升高达6倍。
absEn: We introduce Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2, a hybrid Mamba-Transformer language model designed to increase throughput for reasoning workloads while achieving state-of-the-art accuracy compared to similarly-sized models. Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2 builds on the Nemotron-H architecture, in which the majority of the self-attention layers in the common Transformer architecture are replaced with Mamba-2 layers, to achieve improved inference speed when generating the long thinking traces needed for reasoning. We create Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2 by first pre-training a 12-billion-parameter model (Nemotron-Nano-12B-v2-Base) on 20 trillion tokens using an FP8 training recipe. After aligning Nemotron-Nano-12B-v2-Base, we employ the Minitron strategy to compress and distill the model with the goal of enabling inference on up to 128k tokens on a single NVIDIA A10G GPU (22GiB of memory, bfloat16 precision). Compared to existing similarly-sized models (e.g., Qwen3-8B), we show that Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2 achieves on-par or better accuracy on reasoning benchmarks while achieving up to 6x higher inference throughput in reasoning settings like 8k input and 16k output tokens. We are releasing Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2, Nemotron-Nano12B-v2-Base, and Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2-Base checkpoints along with the majority of our pre- and post-training datasets on Hugging Face.
absZh: 我们介绍了Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2，这是一种混合Mamba-Transformer语言模型，旨在提高推理工作负载的吞吐量，同时在与同等规模模型相比时达到最先进的准确性。Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2基于Nemotron-H架构，其中常见的Transformer架构中的大部分自注意力层被替换为Mamba-2层，从而在生成长思维链（推理所需）时提高推理速度。我们通过首先在20万亿个token上使用FP8训练配方预训练一个120亿参数模型（Nemotron-Nano-12B-v2-Base）来创建Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2。在对齐Nemotron-Nano-12B-v2-Base后，我们采用Minitron策略压缩和蒸馏模型，目标是在单个NVIDIA A10G GPU（22 GiB内存，bfloat16精度）上实现高达128k token的推理。与现有类似规模的模型（例如Qwen3-8B）相比，我们展示Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2在推理基准测试中达到了相当或更好的准确性，同时在推理设置（如8k输入和16k输出token）中实现了高达6倍的推理吞吐量。我们将在Hugging Face上发布Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2、Nemotron-Nano-12B-v2-Base和Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2-Base检查点，以及我们大部分训练前和训练后数据集。

full.sec: NVIDIA Nemotron Nano 2: An Accurate and Efficient Hybrid Mamba-Transformer Reasoning Model
full.secZh: NVIDIA Nemotron Nano 2：一个准确且高效的混合Mamba-Transformer推理模型

items.en: Abstract. We introduce Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2, a hybrid Mamba-Transformer language model designed to increase throughput for reasoning workloads while achieving state-of-the-art accuracy compared to similarly-sized models. Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2 builds on the Nemotron-H architecture, in which the majority of the self-attention layers in the common Transformer architecture are replaced with Mamba-2 layers, to achieve improved inference speed when generating the long thinking traces needed for reasoning. We create Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2 by first pre-training a 12-billion-parameter model (Nemotron-Nano-12B-v2-Base) on 20 trillion tokens using an FP8 training recipe. After aligning Nemotron-Nano-12B-v2-Base, we employ the Minitron strategy to compress and distill the model with the goal of enabling inference on up to 128k tokens on a single NVIDIA A10G GPU (22GiB of memory, bfloat16 precision). Compared to existing similarly-sized models (e.g., Qwen3-8B), we show that Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2 achieves on-par or better accuracy on reasoning benchmarks while achieving up to 6 \(\times\) higher inference throughput in reasoning settings like 8k input and 16k output tokens (Figure 1). We are releasing Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2, Nemotron-Nano-12B-v2-Base, and Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2-Base checkpoints along with the majority of our pre- and post-training datasets on Hugging Face.
items.zh: 摘要。我们介绍了 Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2，这是一个混合 Mamba-Transformer 语言模型，旨在提高推理工作负载的吞吐量，同时在与类似规模模型相比时实现最先进的精度。Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2 建立在 Nemotron-H 架构之上，该架构将常见 Transformer 架构中的大多数自注意力层替换为 Mamba-2 层，以在生成推理所需的长思考轨迹时提高推理速度。我们首先使用 FP8 训练方案在 20 万亿个词元上预训练一个 120 亿参数的模型（Nemotron-Nano-12B-v2-Base），从而创建 Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2。在对齐 Nemotron-Nano-12B-v2-Base 后，我们采用 Minitron 策略压缩和蒸馏模型，目标是能够在单个 NVIDIA A10G GPU（22GiB 内存，bfloat16 精度）上推理多达 128k 个词元。与现有的类似规模模型（例如 Qwen3-8B）相比，我们展示了 Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2 在推理基准上达到相当或更好的精度，同时在推理设置（如 8k 输入和 16k 输出词元）中实现高达 6 倍的推理吞吐量提升（图 1）。我们正在 Hugging Face 上发布 Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2、Nemotron-Nano-12B-v2-Base 和 Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2-Base 检查点，以及我们大部分预训练和后训练数据集。

items.en: We introduce NVIDIA Nemotron Nano 2, a hybrid Mamba-Transformer reasoning model that achieves on par or better benchmark accuracies at \(3\times\) – \(6\times\) higher throughput than Qwen3-8B for generation-heavy scenarios like 1k input / 8k output or 8k input / 16k output tokens (Figure 1). Nemotron Nano 2 builds on the architecture of Nemotron-H, but utilizes key new datasets and recipes for pre-training, alignment, pruning and distillation. We share these recipes, the checkpoints, as well as the majority of the pre- and post-training datasets.
items.zh: 我们推出了 NVIDIA Nemotron Nano 2，这是一种混合 Mamba-Transformer 推理模型，在生成密集型场景（如 1k 输入 / 8k 输出或 8k 输入 / 16k 输出 token，图 1）中，吞吐量比 Qwen3-8B 高 \(3\times\) – \(6\times\)，并且基准测试精度相当或更优。Nemotron Nano 2 基于 Nemotron-H 的架构，但使用了关键的新数据集和预训练、对齐、剪枝及蒸馏方案。我们公开了这些方案、检查点以及大部分预训练和后训练数据集。

Nemotron Nano 2 achieves comparable or better accuracies on complex reasoning benchmarks, while achieving up to 6.3×\times higher throughput for such workloads. items.en: The initial base model, Nemotron-Nano-12B-v2-Base, was pre-trained using FP8 precision (§2.4) over 20 trillion tokens using a Warmup-Stable-Decay learning rate schedule (§2.5). It then underwent a continuous pre-training long-context extension phase to become 128k-capable without degrading other benchmarks (§2.6). Overall, new and improved datasets led to significant accuracy improvements over Nemotron-H-8B on math, multilingual, MMLU-Pro and other benchmarks (§2.2).
items.zh: 初始基础模型 Nemotron-Nano-12B-v2-Base 采用 FP8 精度（§2.4）在 20 万亿 token 上使用 Warmup-Stable-Decay 学习率调度（§2.5）进行预训练。随后，它经历了一个连续预训练长上下文扩展阶段，以支持 128k 上下文而不降低其他基准性能（§2.6）。总体而言，新的和改进的数据集在数学、多语言、MMLU-Pro 等基准测试上相比 Nemotron-H-8B 带来了显著的精度提升（§2.2）。

items.en: Nemotron Nano 2 was then post-trained through a combination of Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT), Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), and Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF). We applied multiple SFT stages across various domains, followed by targeted SFT on key areas such as tool use, long-context performance, and truncated (budgeted) training. GRPO and RLHF sharpened instruction-following and conversational ability, while additional DPO stages further strengthened tool use. Overall, post-training was performed on roughly \(90\) billion tokens, the majority in single-turn prompt–response format with reasoning traces. About \(5\%\) of the data contained deliberately truncated reasoning traces, enabling fine-grained thinking budget control at inference time (§3.4).
items.zh: Nemotron Nano 2 随后通过监督微调（SFT）、群组相对策略优化（GRPO）、直接偏好优化（DPO）和基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）进行组合后训练。我们在多个领域应用了多阶段 SFT，随后在关键领域（如工具使用、长上下文性能和截断（预算）训练）进行定向 SFT。GRPO 和 RLHF 增强了指令遵循和对话能力，而额外的 DPO 阶段进一步强化了工具使用。总体而言，后训练基于大约 \(90\) 亿 token，大部分采用含有推理轨迹的单轮提示-响应对格式。约 \(5\%\) 的数据包含有意识截断的推理轨迹，使得推理时能够精细控制思考预算（§3.4）。

items.en: Finally, both the base model and aligned model were compressed so as to enable inference over context lengths of 128k tokens on a single NVIDIA A10G GPU (22 GiB of memory, bfloat16 precision). This was done by extending a compression strategy based on Minitron to compress reasoning models subject to constraints.
items.zh: 最后，基础模型和对齐模型均经过压缩，以在单个 NVIDIA A10G GPU（22 GiB 内存，bfloat16 精度）上支持 128k token 的上下文长度推理。这是通过扩展基于 Minitron 的压缩策略来压缩受限条件下的推理模型实现的。

items.en: The rest of this technical report is organized as follows: In §2, we discuss the Nemotron Nano 2 model architecture, pre-training process, and base model evaluation results. In §3, we discuss the alignment process. In §4, we describe the pruning and distillation methods used for model compression.
items.zh: 本技术报告的其余部分组织如下：第2节讨论 Nemotron Nano 2 模型架构、预训练过程以及基座模型评估结果。第3节讨论对齐过程。第4节描述用于模型压缩的剪枝和蒸馏方法。

items.en: In this section, we discuss the architecture and pretraining of the Nemotron-Nano-12B-v2-Base model. We also compare this model against other state-of-the-art models in terms of accuracy on popular benchmarks.
items.zh: 在本节中，我们讨论Nemotron-Nano-12B-v2-Base模型的架构与预训练。我们还将该模型与其他最先进模型在常用基准测试上的准确率进行比较。

items.capEn: Figure 2: Nemotron-Nano-12B-v2-Base layer pattern. As in Nemotron-H models, roughly 8% of the total layers in the model are self-attention layers which are evenly dispersed throughout the model.

items.en: As in Nemotron-H, Nemotron-Nano-12B-v2-Base consists of a mixture of Mamba-2, self-attention, and FFN layers. The layer pattern and key architecture details are summarized in Figure 2 and Table 1. Concretely, we use 62 layers, with 6 of them being self-attention layers, 28 being FFN, and 28 being Mamba-2 layers. We use a hidden dimension of 5120, FFN hidden dimension of 20480, and Grouped-Query Attention with 40 query heads and 8 key-value heads. For Mamba-2 layers, we use 8 groups, a state dimension of 128, a head dimension of 64, an expansion factor of 2, and a window size for convolution of 4. For FFN layers, we use squared ReLU activation. Again as in Nemotron-H, we do not use any position embeddings and use RMSNorm, separate embedding and output layer weights, no dropout, and we do not use bias weights for linear layers.
items.zh: 与Nemotron-H一样，Nemotron-Nano-12B-v2-Base由Mamba-2、自注意力机制和FFN层的混合组成。层模式和关键架构细节总结在图2和表1中。具体而言，我们使用62层，其中6个是自注意力层，28个是FFN层，28个是Mamba-2层。我们使用隐藏维度5120，FFN隐藏维度20480，以及分组查询注意力（Grouped-Query Attention），包含40个查询头和8个键值头。对于Mamba-2层，我们使用8个组，状态维度128，头维度64，扩展因子2，卷积窗口大小4。对于FFN层，我们使用平方ReLU激活。同样与Nemotron-H类似，我们不使用任何位置嵌入，采用RMSNorm，分离嵌入层和输出层权重，不使用dropout，且线性层不使用偏置权重。

items.en: Nemotron-Nano-12B-v2-Base was pre-trained on a large corpus of high-quality curated and synthetically-generated data.
items.zh: Nemotron-Nano-12B-v2-Base 在一个大规模、高质量、经过整理和合成生成的数据语料库上进行了预训练。

items.en: We have separate data curation pipelines for the following broad data categories: general web crawl data (English and multilingual), math data, and code data. We discuss each in turn next.
items.zh: 我们对以下广泛的数据类别采用独立的数据策展流程：通用网络爬取数据（英语和多语种）、数学数据和代码数据。下面我们逐一讨论。

items.en: English web crawl data. We used the Nemotron-CC dataset, but updated to include eight more recent Common Crawl snapshots (CC-MAIN-2024-33 through CC-MAIN-2025-13) using the same pipeline. For synthetic rephrasing, we mostly switched to Qwen3-30B-A3B (from Mistral Nemo 12B). Additionally, we used data from CC-NEWS through April 23, 2025, to help improve the knowledge cutoff of the model. The CC-NEWS data was filtered for English and globally fuzzily de-duplicated; no other filtering was used.
items.zh: 英语网络爬取数据。我们使用了 Nemotron-CC 数据集，但通过相同的流程更新纳入了八个更新的 Common Crawl 快照（CC-MAIN-2024-33 至 CC-MAIN-2025-13）。对于合成改写，我们主要转向 Qwen3-30B-A3B（取代 Mistral Nemo 12B）。此外，我们使用了截至 2025 年 4 月 23 日的 CC-NEWS 数据，以帮助改善模型的知识截止日期。CC-NEWS 数据经过英语过滤和全局模糊去重；未使用其他过滤。

items.en: Multilingual data. We extracted data for fifteen languages from the following three Common Crawl snapshots: CC-MAIN-2024-51, CC-MAIN-2025-08, and CC-MAIN-2025-18. The fifteen languages included were Arabic, Chinese, Danish, Dutch, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish, Swedish, and Thai. As we did not have reliable multilingual model-based quality classifiers available, we just applied heuristic filtering instead. This was done in a similar manner to the filtering of low-quality English data in the Nemotron-CC pipeline, except that we had to selectively disable some heuristic filters that had very high false positive rates for some languages. De-duplication was done in the same way as for Nemotron-CC. Additionally, we used data from Wikipedia and FineWeb-2 for these fifteen languages.
items.zh: 多语种数据。我们从以下三个 Common Crawl 快照中提取了十五种语言的数据：CC-MAIN-2024-51、CC-MAIN-2025-08 和 CC-MAIN-2025-18。包含的十五种语言是阿拉伯语、中文、丹麦语、荷兰语、法语、德语、意大利语、日语、韩语、波兰语、葡萄牙语、俄语、西班牙语、瑞典语和泰语。由于我们没有可靠的多语种基于模型的质量分类器，因此仅应用了启发式过滤。其方式类似于 Nemotron-CC 流程中过滤低质量英语数据的方法，但我们必须有选择地禁用一些对某些语言具有极高误报率的启发式过滤器。去重方式与 Nemotron-CC 相同。此外，我们针对这十五种语言使用了来自 Wikipedia 和 FineWeb-2 的数据。

items.en: Math data. Mathematical content on the web is expressed in a wide range of formats, including inline and block LaTeX, MathML, Unicode symbols, and custom renderers such as MathJax or KaTeX. We conducted a detailed analysis of prior math-specific extraction pipelines—including OpenWebMath, MegaMath, jusText, Trafilatura, and Resiliparse—and found that none could reliably preserve mathematical expressions or code structure. These tools frequently discard or distort equations and flatten code formatting, severely limiting the utility of the extracted content for pretraining.
items.zh: 数学数据。网络上的数学内容以多种格式表达，包括行内和块级 LaTeX、MathML、Unicode 符号以及自定义渲染器如 MathJax 或 KaTeX。我们对先前的数学特定提取管道进行了详细分析——包括 OpenWebMath、MegaMath、jusText、Trafilatura 和 Resiliparse——发现没有一种能够可靠地保留数学表达式或代码结构。这些工具经常丢弃或扭曲方程，并扁平化代码格式，严重限制了提取内容对预训练的实用性。

items.en: To address this, we built a new pipeline specifically designed for high-fidelity mathematical extraction from Common Crawl. We first aggregated a comprehensive list of math-related URLs from prior datasets (e.g., InfiMM-WebMath, OpenWebMath, FineMath, and MegaMath), then re-fetched their raw HTML documents from 98 Common Crawl snapshots (2014–2024). Each page was rendered using the lynx text-based browser to preserve layout and math structure. We then applied Phi-4 (14B-parameters) to remove boilerplate, standardize notation into LaTeX, and correct inconsistencies. A FineMath classifier was used to retain high-quality documents, followed by fuzzy deduplication via MinHash-based Locality Sensitive Hashing (LSH) via the NeMo-Curator framework.111https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Curator We finally decontaminated the dataset using LLM Decontaminator.
items.zh: 为了解决这个问题，我们构建了一个专门用于从 Common Crawl 进行高保真数学提取的新管道。我们首先从先前的数据集（例如 InfiMM-WebMath、OpenWebMath、FineMath 和 MegaMath）中聚合了一个全面的数学相关 URL 列表，然后从 98 个 Common Crawl 快照（2014–2024）中重新获取其原始 HTML 文档。每个页面使用基于文本的浏览器 lynx 渲染，以保留布局和数学结构。然后我们应用 Phi-4（14B 参数）去除模板、将符号标准化为 LaTeX 并纠正不一致。使用 FineMath 分类器保留高质量文档，随后通过基于 MinHash 的局部敏感哈希（LSH）和 NeMo-Curator 框架进行模糊去重。111https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Curator 最后，我们使用 LLM Decontaminator 对数据集进行去污染。

items.en: This process resulted in a 133B-token corpus, Nemotron-CC-Math-3+, and a higher-quality 52B-token subset, Nemotron-CC-Math-4+, containing only the top-scoring samples. When used for pretraining, this dataset yields substantial improvements across math (MATH-500), code (HumanEval+, MBPP+, MBPP), and general-domain evaluations (MMLU, MMLU-STEM, MMLU-Pro), surpassing all existing open math datasets. For full details, see .
items.zh: 这一过程产生了包含1330亿词元的语料库Nemotron-CC-Math-3+，以及一个质量更高、仅包含最高分样本的520亿词元子集Nemotron-CC-Math-4+。在预训练中使用该数据集在数学（MATH-500）、代码（HumanEval+、MBPP+、MBPP）和通用领域评估（MMLU、MMLU-STEM、MMLU-Pro）上均取得了显著改进，超越了所有现有的开放数学数据集。完整详情请参见。

items.en: Code data. In line with previous models in the Nemotron family , we pretrained Nemotron-Nano-12B-v2-Base with large-scale raw source code. All source code used to train this model originated from GitHub and went through a multi-stage processing pipeline to arrive at the final source code training data. We performed license-based removal with a license detection pipeline similar to that used by the BigCode project , but with fewer accepted licenses (see Appendix A for additional details). De-duplication is especially important for source code, where many files can be found exactly duplicated across numerous repositories. Consequently we performed both exact (via hashing) and fuzzy deduplication (using MinHash LSH). In order to build a better understanding of each file in our dataset, we annotated all files with a variety of measures and then performed filtering using these annotations. We found the heuristic filters from OpenCoder to be effective and leveraged them to filter files that are less valuable or even detrimental for LLM pretraining.
items.zh: 代码数据。与Nemotron系列之前的模型一致，我们使用大规模原始源代码对Nemotron-Nano-12B-v2-Base进行了预训练。用于训练该模型的所有源代码均来自GitHub，并经过多阶段处理流程得到最终的源代码训练数据。我们使用与BigCode项目类似的许可证检测流程进行了基于许可证的移除，但接受的许可证更少（详见附录A）。去重对于源代码尤其重要，因为许多文件会在多个仓库中完全重复出现。因此，我们同时执行了精确去重（通过哈希）和模糊去重（使用MinHash LSH）。为了更好理解数据集中每个文件，我们用多种度量标准对所有文件进行了标注，然后利用这些标注进行过滤。我们发现OpenCoder的启发式过滤器很有效，并利用它们过滤掉对大语言模型预训练价值较低甚至有害的文件。

items.en: STEM data. We generated synthetic data for STEM subjects, including Astronomy, Biology, Chemistry, Math, and Physics using 88.6k questions collected from multiple sources as the seed data. In addition to the widely used GSM8K, MATH, and AOPS training sets, we collected more diverse questions from Stemez222https://www.stemez.com/ and textbooks with permissive licenses from OpenStax333https://openstax.org and Open Textbook Library.444https://open.umn.edu/opentextbooks/ We used Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct to extract questions from the exercise sections in the textbooks with additional instructions such as dropping question numbering, ignoring questions that require image interpretation, and formatting equations using LaTeX. We manually curated the extracted questions to fix occasional OCR errors and removed non-self-contained questions (e.g., a question that refers to an example in the same chapter).
items.zh: STEM数据。我们使用从多个来源收集的88.6k个问题作为种子数据，为STEM学科（包括天文学、生物学、化学、数学和物理学）生成了合成数据。除了广泛使用的GSM8K、MATH和AOPS训练集外，我们还从Stemez222https://www.stemez.com/以及具有宽松许可的教科书（来自OpenStax333https://openstax.org和开放教科书图书馆444https://open.umn.edu/opentextbooks/）收集了更多多样化的问题。我们使用Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct从教科书的练习部分提取问题，并附带了额外指令，例如去掉问题编号、忽略需要图像解读的问题以及使用LaTeX格式化方程。我们手动整理了提取的问题，修正了偶尔的OCR错误，并移除了非自包含的问题（例如引用同一章节中示例的问题）。

items.en: To expand both the quantity and diversity of questions, we conducted three iterations of question generation using four models (i.e., Qwen3-30B-A3B and Qwen3-235B-A22B, both with thinking mode enabled, Deepseek-R1, and Deepseek V3) and three prompts:
items.zh: 为了扩大问题的数量和多样性，我们使用四个模型（即Qwen3-30B-A3B和Qwen3-235B-A22B，两者都启用了思考模式，Deepseek-R1和Deepseek V3）和三个提示进行了三轮问题生成：

items.en: Similar question: Create a new question that explores similar concepts but offers a fresh challenge.
items.zh: 相似问题：创建一个探索类似概念但提供新挑战的新问题。

items.en: Harder question: Create a new question that requires more logical steps or involves more advanced concepts. Varied question: Create a new question that differs in type from the original question. We instructed the model to avoid superficial or trivial modifications and think through the solution when creating a new question.
items.zh: 更难的问题：创建一个需要更多逻辑步骤或涉及更高级概念的新问题。多样化问题：创建一个与原始问题类型不同的新问题。我们指导模型避免表面或琐碎的修改，并在创建新问题时思考解决方案。

items.en: STEM data. We generated synthetic data for STEM subjects, including Astronomy, Biology, Chemistry, Math, and Physics using 88.6k questions collected from multiple sources as the seed data. In addition to the widely used GSM8K, MATH, and AOPS training sets, we collected more diverse questions from Stemez222https://www.stemez.com/ and textbooks with permissive licenses from OpenStax333https://openstax.org and Open Textbook Library.444https://open.umn.edu/opentextbooks/ We used Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct to extract questions from the exercise sections in the textbooks with additional instructions such as dropping question numbering, ignoring questions that require image interpretation, and formatting equations using LaTeX. We manually curated the extracted questions to fix occasional OCR errors and removed non-self-contained questions (e.g., a question that refers to an example in the same chapter).

We filtered out duplicates and highly-similar questions using fuzzy de-duplication and generated solutions to the remaining questions with the models used in the question generation step. We converted a subset of examples to multiple-choice questions in MMLU or MMLU-Pro style. We constructed a few thousand few-shot examples by concatenating random synthetic samples.
items.zh: 我们使用模糊去重过滤掉重复和高度相似的问题，并用问题生成步骤中使用的模型为剩余问题生成解决方案。我们将一部分示例转换为MMLU或MMLU-Pro风格的多选题。通过拼接随机合成样本，我们构建了几千个少样本示例。

items.en: Math data. We also revisited and regenerated the Nemotron-MIND dataset , a math-informed synthetic pretraining corpus originally built on OpenWebMath. In our updated version, we regenerated the MIND dataset using Nemotron-CC-Math-4+, our highest-quality math subset comprising 52B tokens—as the source corpus. Following the original methodology, we applied seven prompt templates (e.g., Teacher–Student, Debate, Interview, etc) to generate structured mathematical dialogues using the Phi-4 model. Unlike the original MIND, which relied on 14.7B tokens of lower-fidelity data, our version leverages significantly higher-quality input and processes it with a chunk size of 5K tokens. This regeneration produced a 73B-token synthetic dataset and led to consistent improvements across math reasoning and general knowledge (MMLU, MMLU-Pro. MMLU-Stem) benchmarks compared to the original MIND version, highlighting the critical role of input data quality. Full details and results are available in .
items.zh: 数学数据。我们还重新审视并重新生成了Nemotron-MIND数据集，这是一个最初基于OpenWebMath构建的数学信息合成预训练语料库。在我们的更新版本中，我们使用Nemotron-CC-Math-4+（我们最高质量的数学子集，包含520亿词元）作为源语料库，重新生成了MIND数据集。遵循原始方法论，我们应用了七种提示模板（例如，教师-学生、辩论、面试等），使用Phi-4模型生成结构化数学对话。与原始MIND（依赖于147亿词元的较低保真度数据）不同，我们的版本利用了显著更高质量的输入，并以5K词元的块大小进行处理。这次重新生成了一个730亿词元的合成数据集，并在数学推理和通用知识（MMLU、MMLU-Pro、MMLU-Stem）基准测试上相比原始MIND版本带来了一致的改进，突显了输入数据质量的关键作用。完整细节和结果见[原文]。

items.en: Multilingual data. We generated multilingual diverse question and answer data (Diverse QA) from two sources:
items.zh: 多语言数据。我们从两个来源生成了多语言多样化问答数据（Diverse QA）：

items.en: We translated the English Diverse QA data to fifteen languages (see Multilingual data) using Qwen3-30B-A3B.
items.zh: 我们使用Qwen3-30B-A3B将英文Diverse QA数据翻译成十五种语言（参见多语言数据）。

items.en: We generated synthetic data from Wikipedia articles in these languages using the Diverse QA prompt and instructed the model to write all questions and answers in the target language.
items.zh: 我们使用Diverse QA提示从这些语言的维基百科文章生成合成数据，并指示模型以目标语言编写所有问题和答案。

items.en: In addition, we translated a subset of our GSM8K augmentation data (see STEM data) into these languages using Qwen3-30B-A3B. We post-processed each translated solution by appending a concluding sentence meaning “The answer is …” (e.g., “La respuesta es …” in Spanish, “Die Antwort lautet …” in German), where the final numerical answer is extracted from the original English solution.
items.zh: 此外，我们使用Qwen3-30B-A3B将GSM8K增强数据的一个子集（参见STEM数据）翻译成这些语言。我们对每个翻译后的解答进行后处理，添加一个结尾句，意思为“答案是……”（例如，西班牙语中为“La respuesta es …”，德语中为“Die Antwort lautet …”），其中最终的数字答案从原始英文解答中提取。

items.en: Code data. We generated question-answer (QA) data at scale for 11 different programming languages by prompting an LLM to generate questions based on short snippets from our curated source code, asking the model to solve the generated question, and then performing post hoc filtering of the generated QA pairs based on heuristics as appropriate (e.g., Python AST parsing). This technique results in diverse synthetic data targeted at problem solving containing both natural language and source code. Further details are covered in the Nemotron-H technical report, where we first leveraged this type of synthetic code data in pretraining.
items.zh: 代码数据。我们通过提示大语言模型（LLM）基于我们精选的源代码短片段生成问题，让模型解决生成的问题，然后根据适当的启发式方法（例如Python AST解析）对生成的问答对进行事后过滤，从而为11种不同编程语言大规模生成问答数据。这种技术产生了多样化的合成数据，针对问题解决，同时包含自然语言和源代码。更多细节见Nemotron-H技术报告，我们首次在预训练中利用了这种类型的合成代码数据。

items.en: Academic data. In the pretraining set for the Nemotron-H series of models, we assigned attribute labels for educational quality, educational difficulty, and educational subject to all documents coming from academic data, which encompasses textbooks and academic papers. As content of higher educational difficulty in technical domains still proves challenging for models, we prioritized increasing model comprehension of such information in our current pretraining set via the generation of question-answer (QA) pairs as such data has been shown to enhance knowledge storage and extraction within language models.
items.zh: 学术数据。在Nemotron-H系列模型的预训练集中，我们为来自学术数据的所有文档分配了教育质量、教育难度和教育学科属性标签，这些数据包括教科书和学术论文。由于技术领域教育难度较高的内容对模型仍然具有挑战性，我们优先通过生成问答对来增加模型在当前预训练集中对此类信息的理解，因为此类数据已被证明能增强语言模型内的知识存储和提取。

items.en: To do so, we first gathered all documents with educational difficulty at the undergraduate and graduate levels in the following technical subject areas: math, chemistry, biology, physics, and medicine. Using this subset of documents, we aim to find the most relevant pieces of texts that could be utilized as seed contexts for our generation of QA pairs. We chunk each document into snippets of 512 token lengths, embed them with the e5-large model, and store them within a Milvus vector database that enables approximate nearest neighbor search. We then curate documents from a set of complex subject areas (e.g. Mathematics: Real Analysis, Biology: Genetics, Statistics: Information Theory), and query the Milvus database for the 250 nearest neighbor text snippets to each query document. The returned snippets function as our seed contexts that we then pass into a Qwen-2.5 72B instruct model to generate multiple choice and free response style QA pairs based on the information contained in the snippet. With each QA pair, a justification for the answer is additionally generated.
items.zh: 为此，我们首先收集了以下技术学科领域中本科和研究生级别的所有教育难度文档：数学、化学、生物学、物理学和医学。利用这些文档子集，我们旨在找到最相关的文本片段，作为生成问答对的种子上下文。我们将每个文档切分为512个token长度的片段，使用e5-large模型进行嵌入，并将其存储在支持近似最近邻搜索的Milvus向量数据库中。然后，我们从一组复杂学科领域（例如数学：实分析，生物学：遗传学，统计学：信息论）中精选文档，并查询Milvus数据库，为每个查询文档找到250个最近邻文本片段。返回的片段作为种子上下文，随后我们将其输入到Qwen-2.5 72B指令模型中，基于片段中包含的信息生成多项选择和自由回答风格的问答对。每个问答对还额外生成答案的论证。

items.en: SFT-style data. Using SFT-style data in the later stages of pretraining has shown to be helpful to foster more comprehensive model learning.
items.zh: SFT风格数据。在预训练后期使用SFT风格数据已被证明有助于促进更全面的模型学习。

items.en: Therefore, we synthesized and included different SFT-style data covering several domains: 1) code SFT data which is mainly focused on solving code problems; 2) math SFT data that is mostly focused on reasoning; 3) MMLU-style SFT data which contains different question and answer examples covering different knowledge topics; and 4) general instruction following SFT data.
items.zh: 因此，我们合成并加入了覆盖多个领域的多种SFT风格数据：1) 代码SFT数据，主要专注于解决代码问题；2) 数学SFT数据，主要专注于推理；3) MMLU风格SFT数据，包含覆盖不同知识主题的各种问答示例；4) 通用指令遵循SFT数据。

items.en: We ensure that the SFT-style data covers diverse topics with different difficulty levels for each of the above-mentioned domains. Detailed synthesis methods and pipelines for the above-mentioned SFT data can be found in prior work.
items.zh: 我们确保SFT风格数据覆盖了上述每个领域中的不同主题和难度级别。上述SFT数据的详细合成方法和流程可在先前工作中找到。

items.en: Fundamental reasoning SFT-style data. While the above-mentioned SFT-style data help enhance an LLM’s ability to answer questions in code, math and general language understanding benchmarks, they do not help improve the model’s ability in deeper reasoning tasks to discern the correct answer among a larger pool of potential distractors. We propose to mitigate that by synthesizing SFT-style data focused on analytical reasoning, logical reasoning, and reading comprehension.
items.zh: 基础推理SFT风格数据。虽然上述SFT风格数据有助于增强LLM在代码、数学和通用语言理解基准测试中回答问题的能力，但它们无助于提高模型在更深层推理任务中从大量潜在干扰项中辨别正确答案的能力。我们建议通过合成专注于分析推理、逻辑推理和阅读理解能力的SFT风格数据来缓解这一问题。

items.en: Specifically, we collected existing datasets including 1) the Law School Admission Test (LSAT) dataset, which encompasses three tasks: logical reasoning, reading comprehension, and analytical reasoning; 2) the repurposed LogiQA dataset, which contains various types of logical reasoning questions collected from the National Civil Servants Examination of China; and 3) the AQuA-RAT dataset, which emphasizes algebraic word problems. We then prompted DeepSeek-V3 and Qwen3-30B-A3B respectively to synthesize more similar questions with corresponding options. For each question we generated, we prompted DeepSeek-V3 again to generate the chain-of-thought (CoT) process with the final solution. At the post-processing stage, we apply majority voting to keep only the samples that have the most voted solutions. Overall, we generated 4B tokens from DeepSeek-V3 and 4.2B tokens from Qwen3-30B models.
items.zh: 具体来说，我们收集了现有数据集，包括：1) 法学院入学考试(LSAT)数据集，包含三个任务：逻辑推理、阅读理解和分析推理；2) 重新利用的LogiQA数据集，包含从中国国家公务员考试中收集的各类逻辑推理问题；3) AQuA-RAT数据集，侧重于代数应用题。然后我们分别提示DeepSeek-V3和Qwen3-30B-A3B来合成更多类似问题和对应选项。对于生成的每个问题，我们再次提示DeepSeek-V3生成思维链(CoT)过程及最终答案。在后处理阶段，我们采用多数投票法，仅保留得票最多的样本。总体而言，我们从DeepSeek-V3生成了4B词元，从Qwen3-30B模型生成了4.2B词元。

items.en: Our data mixture consists of thirteen data categories. The largest is web crawl data, which we subdivided into four categories based on the Nemotron-CC quality classification: crawl-medium, crawl-medium-high, crawl-high, syn-crawl-high, denoting medium, medium-high, high, and synthetic quality crawl data, respectively. Apart from these, our data mixture has additional categories such as math, Wikipedia, code, academic data, crawl++, multilingual, and synthetic SFT-style data, which is further categorized as general-sft, stem-sft, and code-sft. Crawl++ consists of web-crawl derivatives like OpenWebText, BigScience, and Reddit. Our multilingual data has fifteen languages: Arabic, Danish, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Polish, Swedish, Thai, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, and Russian. We design the data mixtures to give similar weight to data sources that have similar quality. Data sources of higher quality are weighted higher than data sources of lower quality. We provide detailed explanation on quality estimation of datasets and the blend creation process in and .
items.zh: 我们的数据混合包含十三个数据类别。最大的是网络爬虫数据，我们根据Nemotron-CC质量分类将其细分为四个类别：crawl-medium、crawl-medium-high、crawl-high、syn-crawl-high，分别表示中等、中高、高和合成质量的爬虫数据。除此之外，我们的数据混合还包括其他类别，如数学、维基百科、代码、学术数据、crawl++、多语言和合成SFT风格数据，这些进一步分为general-sft、stem-sft和code-sft。Crawl++包含网络爬虫衍生数据，如OpenWebText、BigScience和Reddit。我们的多语言数据涵盖十五种语言：阿拉伯语、丹麦语、德语、西班牙语、法语、意大利语、葡萄牙语、荷兰语、波兰语、瑞典语、泰语、汉语、日语、韩语和俄语。我们设计数据混合时，对质量相似的数据源赋予相似的权重。质量较高的数据源权重高于质量较低的数据源。我们在和章节中详细说明了数据集质量评估和混合创建过程。

items.en: We used a curriculum based on three phases of data-blending approach to pre-train Nemotron-Nano-12B-v2-Base. In the first phase, we used a data mixture that promotes diversity in data; in the second and third phases, we primarily used high-quality datasets (e.g., Wikipedia). We switched to the second phase at the 60% point of training, and to the third phase at the 90% point of training. The data mixtures used in each phase are shown in Figure 3.
items.zh: 我们采用基于三阶段数据混合方法的课程来预训练Nemotron-Nano-12B-v2-Base。在第一阶段，我们使用促进数据多样性的数据混合；在第二和第三阶段，我们主要使用高质量数据集（如维基百科）。我们在训练进度的60%处切换到第二阶段，在90%处切换到第三阶段。每个阶段使用的数据混合如图3所示。

items.en: In Section 2.2, we mentioned several large categories of multilingual data, both curated and synthetic:
items.zh: 在 2.2 节中，我们提到了几大类多语言数据，包括整理过的和合成数据：

items.en: Common Crawl: Extracted from recent Common Crawl snapshots using our own pipeline.
items.zh: Common Crawl：使用我们自己的流程从最近的 Common Crawl 快照中提取。

items.en: DiverseQA-wiki: Generated from multilingual Wikipedia articles using a translated Diverse QA prompt.
items.zh: DiverseQA-wiki：使用翻译后的 Diverse QA 提示从多语言维基百科文章生成。

items.en: DiverseQA-crawl: Translated from English Diverse QA data.
items.zh: DiverseQA-crawl：从英语 Diverse QA 数据翻译而来。

items.en: In order to decide the proper data mixture among these different multilingual data sources, we first conducted ablation experiments to compare the downstream task performance of the four multilingual data sources.
items.zh: 为了确定这些不同多语言数据源之间的合适数据混合比例，我们首先进行了消融实验，以比较四个多语言数据源的下游任务性能。

items.en: Specifically, we took a 1B model checkpoint that had been trained for 350B tokens, and continuously pre-trained it for another 100B tokens. We assigned 50% of the continuous pre-training data to multilingual data, and the remaining 50% use our default pre-training data mixture. We evaluated each model’s performance using the Global-MMLU benchmark; the results are shown in Table 2. Our curated Common Crawl-based multilingual data performed slightly better than the Fineweb2-based multilingual data, while the synthesized multilingual QA pairs performed much better than the curated multilingual web crawl data. The diverse pairs translated from English Common Crawl achieved the highest average score over the 8 languages we evaluated on. Therefore, we assigned a much higher weight to the DiverseQA-crawl data than the other categories when deciding our multilingual data mixture.
items.zh: 具体来说，我们取了一个经过 350B token 训练的 1B 模型检查点，并对其进行了额外的 100B token 的持续预训练。我们将持续预训练数据的 50% 分配给多语言数据，剩余 50% 使用我们的默认预训练数据混合。我们使用 Global-MMLU 基准评估每个模型的性能，结果如表 2 所示。我们基于 Common Crawl 策划的多语言数据表现略优于基于 Fineweb2 的多语言数据，而合成的多语言 QA 对数据表现远优于策划的多语言网络爬取数据。从英文 Common Crawl 翻译的多样化 QA 对在我们评估的 8 种语言上取得了最高平均分数。因此，在决定我们的多语言数据混合时，我们为 DiverseQA-crawl 数据分配了比其他类别高得多的权重。

full.sec: 2.3.2 Fundamental Reasoning SFT-Style Data Ablation Study
full.secZh: 2.3.2 基础推理微调风格数据消融研究

items.en: To show the effectiveness of the fundamental reasoning (FR) focused SFT-style data we introduced in Section 2.2, we took the Nemotron-H-8B intermediate checkpoint trained over 14.5T tokens, and continuously pre-trained it with another 100B tokens. We assigned 5% of the 100B tokens to the newly synthesized FR-SFT data (as a replacement for Common Crawl data), and kept all other data categories the same as in the Nemotron-H-8B’s phase 3 blend. We compared this model with Nemotron-H-8B, which had also been trained with 14.6T tokens. The detailed evaluation benchmarks are introduced in Section 2.7. The comparison results are shown in Table 3. The SFT-style data helped improve the Nemotron-H-8B model’s performance on MMLU-Pro from 44.24 to 56.36, and also helped increase the average MATH score by around 2 points. While MMLU-Pro is a more challenging benchmark that evaluates a model’s language understanding capability, it also requires the model to have excellent reasoning capability to select the correct answer out of ten choices. Our SFT data helps equip the model to select the correct answers from the other nine distractors through fundamental reasoning. We noticed no decrease in the average commonsense reasoning and average code benchmarks.
items.zh: 为了展示第2.2节中介绍的基础推理（FR）微调风格数据的有效性，我们选取了在14.5T token上训练的Nemotron-H-8B中间检查点，并用另外100B token对其进行了继续预训练。我们将100B token中的5%分配给了新合成的FR-SFT数据（作为Common Crawl数据的替换），而其他所有数据类别与Nemotron-H-8B的阶段3混合保持一致。我们将该模型与同样在14.6T token上训练的Nemotron-H-8B进行了比较。详细的评估基准在第2.7节中介绍。比较结果如表3所示。微调风格数据帮助Nemotron-H-8B模型在MMLU-Pro上的性能从44.24提升到56.36，并将MATH平均分提高了约2分。虽然MMLU-Pro是一个更难的基准，用于评估模型的语言理解能力，但它也需要模型具备出色的推理能力，从十个选项中选出正确答案。我们的SFT数据帮助模型通过基础推理从其他九个干扰项中选出正确答案。我们注意到在平均常识推理和平均代码基准测试上没有下降。

items.en: We used DeepSeek’s FP8 training recipe for the entirety of the pretraining run. Specifically, we used E4M3 for all tensors, 128x128 quantization blocks for weights, and 1x128 tiles for the activations. Unlike Nemotron-H, we natively kept the model weights in E4M3 so that we could do the distributed optimizer’s parameter all-gather operations (across data-parallel replicas) in FP8; master weights are still kept in FP32. One exception to DeepSeek’s formula was that we left the first and last four linear layers in BF16, as done with Nemotron-H. Also unlike the DeepSeek-V3 run, we left all optimizer state in FP32. We observed no training instabilities from this choice of numerics.
items.zh: 我们在整个预训练过程中使用了DeepSeek的FP8训练方案。具体来说，我们对所有张量采用E4M3格式，权重使用128×128量化块，激活值使用1×128瓦片。与Nemotron-H不同，我们将模型权重原生保留为E4M3格式，以便在FP8下执行分布式优化器的参数全收集操作（跨数据并行副本）；主权重仍保持为FP32。DeepSeek公式的一个例外是，我们像Nemotron-H一样，将第一个和最后四个线性层保留为BF16格式。此外，与DeepSeek-V3运行不同，我们将所有优化器状态保留为FP32。我们观察到这种数值选择没有带来训练不稳定性。

items.en: We trained Nemotron-Nano-12B-v2-Base on a token horizon of 20 trillion tokens. We used a sequence length of 8192 and global batch size of 768 (6,029,312 tokens per batch). We did not use any batch size ramp-up. We used a WSD (Warmup-Stable-Decay) learning rate schedule with a "stable" learning rate of \(4.5\cdot 10^{-4}\) and a minimum value of \(4.5\cdot 10^{-6}\); the learning rate was decayed over the final 3.6 trillion tokens. Weight decay was set to 0.1, and Adam \(\beta_{1}\) and \(\beta_{2}\) were set to 0.9 and 0.95 respectively.
items.zh: 我们在20万亿词元的词元视野上训练了Nemotron-Nano-12B-v2-Base。我们使用了8192的序列长度和768的全局批量大小（每批6,029,312词元）。我们没有使用任何批量大小预热。我们采用了WSD（预热-稳定-衰减）学习率调度，其中“稳定”学习率为\(4.5\cdot 10^{-4}\)，最小值为\(4.5\cdot 10^{-6}\)；学习率在最后的3.6万亿词元上衰减。权重衰减设置为0.1，Adam的\(\beta_{1}\)和\(\beta_{2}\)分别设置为0.9和0.95。

items.en: To ensure Nemotron-Nano-12B-v2-Base can infer over long context windows, we added a long-context phase (Phase LC) after Phase 3 of pre-training. In Phase LC, we did continuous pretraining (CPT) with a context length of 524,288 (512k) tokens using a constant learning rate of \(4.5\cdot 10^{-6}\). Although the target context length of Nemotron Nano 2 is 128k, in preliminary studies on the Nemotron-H 8B model, we found it better to do CPT with 512k sequence length, instead of 256k or 128k. Our intuition is that longer training sequence can effectively lower the chance of long coherent documents being cut and separated by the Concat & Chunk algorithm for pretraining data loading. We used 8-way tensor model parallelism and 16-way context parallelism to ensure training with sequence lengths of 512k tokens still fits in GPU memory. We used a global batch size of 12 to ensure the total number of tokens per global batch during long-context CPT is the same as during pretraining: around 6M tokens. Phase LC consisted of 18.9 billion tokens.
items.zh: 为确保Nemotron-Nano-12B-v2-Base能够在长上下文窗口上进行推理，我们在预训练的第3阶段之后增加了一个长上下文阶段（Phase LC）。在Phase LC中，我们使用恒定学习率\(4.5\cdot 10^{-6}\)进行了上下文长度为524,288（512k）个token的连续预训练（CPT）。尽管Nemotron Nano 2的目标上下文长度为128k，但在Nemotron-H 8B模型的初步研究中，我们发现使用512k序列长度进行CPT效果优于256k或128k。我们的直觉是，更长的训练序列可以有效降低长连贯文档被预训练数据加载的Concat & Chunk算法切割和分离的概率。我们使用了8路张量模型并行和16路上下文并行，以确保序列长度为512k token的训练仍然适合GPU内存。我们使用全局批次大小12，以确保长上下文CPT期间每个全局批次的总token数与预训练期间相同：约600万token。Phase LC共包含189亿个token。

items.en: Additionally, we did long-context synthetic data generation to create more high-quality data for Phase LC. Since the academic pretraining dataset is a good source of coherent long-context documents, we used such documents that are longer than 32k tokens as seed data. We followed the methods mentioned in the Llama-3 and Qwen-2.5 tech reports to generate long-context document QA data. We split each document into chunks of 1,024 tokens and then randomly selected 10% of the chunks to be fed into Qwen-2.5-72B-Instruct for data synthesis. We asked the generator to generate a QA pair based on the information in the text chunk. We concatenated the QA pairs and appended them to the end of the original document as a sample of the long-context document QA data. Such long-document QA provided good material for the model to learn long-context dependencies. See Table 4 for ablation results on Nemotron-H 8B regarding train sequence lengths and the effects of synthetic data.
items.zh: 此外，我们进行了长上下文合成数据生成，为Phase LC创建更多高质量数据。由于学术预训练数据集是连贯长上下文文档的良好来源，我们使用那些长度超过32k token的文档作为种子数据。我们遵循Llama-3和Qwen-2.5技术报告中提到的方法来生成长上下文文档问答数据。我们将每个文档分割成1,024 token的块，然后随机选择其中10%的块输入Qwen-2.5-72B-Instruct进行数据合成。我们要求生成器根据文本块中的信息生成一个问答对。我们将这些问答对拼接起来，并附加到原始文档的末尾，作为长上下文文档问答数据的一个样本。这种长文档问答为模型学习长上下文依赖关系提供了良好素材。关于训练序列长度和合成数据效果的消融实验结果，请参见表4。

items.en: The data blend used in Phase LC was built based on that of Phase 3. We proportionally downscaled the weights of all Phase 3 data to 80% of their original values, allocating the remaining 20% to the newly added long-context document-QA data. We found such a blend could effectively extend the context length of Nemotron-Nano-12B-v2-Base without degrading regular benchmark scores.
items.zh: Phase LC中使用的数据混合基于第3阶段的数据构建。我们将第3阶段所有数据的权重按比例缩小至原始值的80%，将剩余的20%分配给新添加的长上下文文档问答数据。我们发现这种混合能够有效扩展Nemotron-Nano-12B-v2-Base的上下文长度，同时不影响常规基准得分。

items.en: We run evaluations of all models ourselves unless otherwise stated. Our evaluation setup is built on top of lm-evaluation-harness (https://github.com/EleutherAI/lm-evaluation-harness) for fair comparisons, with the following changes:
items.zh: 除非另有说明，我们自行对所有模型进行评估。我们的评估框架基于 lm-evaluation-harness（https://github.com/EleutherAI/lm-evaluation-harness）构建，以实现公平比较，并做了以下改动：

items.en: For mathematical reasoning, we evaluate GSM8K and MATH benchmarks using greedy-decoding. We also highlight the competition-level slice of the MATH benchmark as "MATH Level 5". Additionally, we report the \(\text{pass}@32\) performance on AIME-2024. We use Math-Verify (https://github.com/huggingface/math-verify) to grade all generations.
items.zh: 对于数学推理，我们使用贪心解码评估 GSM8K 和 MATH 基准。我们还特别强调 MATH 基准中的竞赛级子集为“MATH Level 5”。此外，我们报告了在 AIME-2024 上的 \(\text{pass}@32\) 性能。我们使用 Math-Verify（https://github.com/huggingface/math-verify）对所有生成结果进行评分。

items.en: For code tasks (HumanEval, MBPP) we evaluate the EvalPlus variants along with the sanitization of generations, in a 0-shot setup. We estimate \(\text{avg}@32\) and \(\text{pass}@1\) from 32 generations per prompt.
items.zh: 对于代码任务（HumanEval、MBPP），我们在零样本设置下评估 EvalPlus 变体，并对生成结果进行清理。我们通过每个提示生成 32 个结果来估计 \(\text{avg}@32\) 和 \(\text{pass}@1\)。

items.en: General reasoning benchmarks (OpenBookQA, PIQA, Hellaswag, Winogrande) are unchanged except for ARC-Challenge, where we present all options at the same time, similar to MMLU.
items.zh: 通用推理基准（OpenBookQA、PIQA、Hellaswag、Winogrande）保持不变，除了 ARC-Challenge，我们在该基准中同时呈现所有选项，类似于 MMLU。

items.en: For multilingual capability, we evaluate MGSM (8-shot, native CoT) and Global MMLU-Lite.
items.zh: 对于多语言能力，我们评估 MGSM（8-shot，原生思维链）和 Global MMLU-Lite。

items.en: We use RULER as the long context benchmark. We report the average scores over all the 13 tasks included in RULER.
items.zh: 我们采用 RULER 作为长上下文基准，报告所有 13 个任务的平均得分。

items.en: Accuracy results for Nemotron-Nano-12B-v2-Base with comparisons to Qwen3-8B Base and Gemma3-12B Base are shown in Tables 5 and 6. We also include the accuracy of our 9B pruned variant of Nemotron-Nano-12B-v2-Base which is discussed in Section 4.
items.zh: Nemotron-Nano-12B-v2-Base 的准确率结果以及与 Qwen3-8B Base 和 Gemma3-12B Base 的比较见表 5 和表 6。我们还列出了 Nemotron-Nano-12B-v2-Base 的 9B 剪枝变体的准确率（详见第 4 节）。

items.en: In this section we will present the alignment process we followed to convert the base checkpoint into an aligned 12B checkpoint. Our process is outlined in Figure 4.
items.zh: 在本节中，我们将介绍将基础检查点转换为对齐后的12B检查点所遵循的对齐过程。我们的过程如图4所示。

items.en: Our alignment process begins with a large-scale supervised fine-tuning (SFT) stage, where the base model is trained on approximately 80 billion tokens of prompt-response pairs. The distribution of domains is shown in Table 7.
items.zh: 我们的对齐过程始于一个大规模监督微调（SFT）阶段，该阶段在约800亿个提示-响应对上训练基础模型。各领域的分布见表7。

items.en: For Math, Science, and Coding data, we generate responses using the open-weight DeepSeek-R1-0528 model, employing the same prompts used for training the Nemotron-H-8B and 47B Reasoning models. The training data has been released as part of the Nemotron-Post-Training-Dataset-v1 (https://huggingface.co/datasets/nvidia/Nemotron-Post-Training-Dataset-v1).
items.zh: 对于数学、科学和编程数据，我们使用开放权重的DeepSeek-R1-0528模型生成响应，采用与训练Nemotron-H-8B和47B推理模型相同的提示。该训练数据已作为Nemotron-Post-Training-Dataset-v1的一部分发布（https://huggingface.co/datasets/nvidia/Nemotron-Post-Training-Dataset-v1）。

items.en: The tool-calling dataset consists of single-turn, multi-turn, and multi-step conversations. For single-turn cases, we sample prompts from xlam-function-calling-60k, glaive-function-calling-v2, and NVIDIA-When2Call, and generate responses using Qwen3-235B-A22B. Inspired by ToolACE and APIGen-MT, we extend this to multi-turn and multi-step settings by simulating conversations where Qwen3-235B-A22B plays the roles of User-Agent, Assistant-Agent, and API-Server-Agent. The User-Agent reviews available tools, poses challenging queries, interacts when addressed by the Assistant, and judges task success at the end. Each instance is paired with a random persona from Nemotron-Personas to enrich the diversity of queries.
items.zh: 工具调用数据集包括单轮、多轮和多步对话。对于单轮情况，我们从xlam-function-calling-60k、glaive-function-calling-v2和NVIDIA-When2Call采样提示，并使用Qwen3-235B-A22B生成响应。受ToolACE和APIGen-MT启发，我们将其扩展到多轮和多步设置，模拟对话中Qwen3-235B-A22B扮演用户智能体、助手智能体和API服务器智能体的角色。用户智能体审查可用工具、提出挑战性查询、在被助手询问时进行交互，并在最后判断任务是否成功。每个实例与来自Nemotron-Personas的随机角色配对，以丰富查询的多样性。

items.en: The Assistant-Agent receives the initial query and available tools, executes tasks by invoking tools, interpreting their responses, and interacting with the User-Agent across single-turn, multi-turn, or multi-step scenarios. Meanwhile, the API-Server-Agent acts as a mock API server, checking parameters and returning either valid outputs or error messages depending on correctness. A lightweight rule-based tool-call verification layer further strengthens reliability by ensuring outputs are consistent and verifiable, and only successful trajectories are retained.
items.zh: 助手智能体接收初始查询和可用工具，通过调用工具、解释响应并与用户智能体交互来执行任务，涵盖单轮、多轮或多步场景。同时，API服务器智能体充当模拟API服务器，检查参数并根据正确性返回有效输出或错误消息。一个轻量级的基于规则的工具调用验证层进一步增强可靠性，确保输出一致且可验证，并且仅保留成功的轨迹。

items.en: Our multilingual synthetic post-training data is constructed by translating existing English post-training data. To address the challenges of large language model (LLM) hallucinations and quality degradation on long inputs when generating synthetic translation data, we implement a robust quality assurance pipeline. Our method involves translating inputs line-by-line to manage complexity and skip non-translatable content like code. We also enforce a strict bracket format for reliable extraction and use language identification to filter out off-target translations, thereby ensuring high-quality final outputs.
items.zh: 我们的多语言合成后训练数据是通过翻译现有的英文后训练数据构建的。为了解决生成合成翻译数据时大型语言模型（LLM）的幻觉和长输入质量下降的挑战，我们实施了一个稳健的质量保证流程。我们的方法包括逐行翻译输入以管理复杂性并跳过代码等不可翻译内容。我们还强制执行严格的括号格式以便于可靠提取，并使用语言识别来过滤脱靶翻译，从而确保高质量最终输出。

items.en: For conversational data, we use prompts from the LMSYS dataset and generate responses using the Qwen3-235B-A22B reasoning model. We also incorporate prompts from HelpSteer2 and HelpSteer3, paired with responses generated by the same model. In addition, we draw on a subset of approximately 550k prompts from WildChat-1M, again generating reasoning responses with Qwen3-235B-A22B. We also include multi-turn conversations with DeepSeek R1 responses using the multi-turn conversational prompts used in.
items.zh: 对于对话数据，我们使用LMSYS数据集中的提示，并使用Qwen3-235B-A22B推理模型生成回复。我们还纳入了HelpSteer2和HelpSteer3中的提示，并与同一模型生成的回复配对。此外，我们利用WildChat-1M中约55万条的提示子集，再次使用Qwen3-235B-A22B生成推理回复。我们还包含了使用DeepSeek R1回复的多轮对话，这些回复基于所用多轮对话提示。

items.en: We leveraged a mix of harmful and benign prompts drawn from the Nemotron Content Safety Dataset V2 (https://huggingface.co/datasets/nvidia/Aegis-AI-Content-Safety-Dataset-2.0), HarmfulTasks, RedTeam2K, and gretel-v1. Responses were generated using DeepSeek-R1-0528 (https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1). To ensure safety, we applied a two-step approach: initial prompting followed by filtering with guard models to verify that outputs remained safe.
items.zh: 我们利用了来自Nemotron内容安全数据集V2 (https://huggingface.co/datasets/nvidia/Aegis-AI-Content-Safety-Dataset-2.0)、HarmfulTasks、RedTeam2K和gretel-v1的有害和良性提示混合。回复使用DeepSeek-R1-0528 (https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1)生成。为确保安全，我们采用了两步方法：首先进行初始提示，然后使用防护模型进行过滤以验证输出保持安全。

items.en: As Figure 4 illustrates, we employ three distinct stages of supervised fine-tuning. Stage 1 uses the full dataset described in Section 3.1, augmented with a subsample of roughly 10% of prompts paired with outputs stripped of reasoning traces. This exposes the model to “empty” traces, enabling it to produce direct answers in a reasoning-off mode. To improve efficiency and preserve long-context ability from pretraining, we concatenate samples into sequences of approximately \(128\) k tokens, reducing padding overhead and encouraging long-range learning.
items.zh: 如图4所示，我们采用三个不同阶段的监督微调。阶段1使用第3.1节所述的全数据集，并额外添加约10%的提示子样本，这些提示的输出去除了推理痕迹。这让模型接触到“空”痕迹，使其能够在推理关闭模式下直接生成答案。为提高效率并保留预训练中的长上下文能力，我们将样本拼接成约\(128\)k令牌的序列，减少了填充开销并鼓励长程学习。

items.en: Stage 2 targets tool-calling. Although Stage 1 improved performance on most benchmarks, tool-calling accuracy degraded. We attribute this to sample concatenation at \(128\) k, which likely disrupted learning of tool-calling patterns. Thus, Stage 2 was trained without concatenation, using the full tool-calling dataset and a representative subsample of other domains.
items.zh: 阶段2针对工具调用。尽管阶段1在大多数基准上提升了性能，但工具调用的准确性下降了。我们将其归因于\(128\)k的样本拼接，可能干扰了工具调用模式的学习。因此，阶段2采用无拼接训练，使用了完整的工具调用数据集和其他领域的代表性子样本。

items.en: Stage 3 reinforces long-context capability. It incorporates long-context data following the recipe used in Nemotron-H preparation, along with augmented examples across domains where reasoning traces were abruptly truncated to 1–2k tokens while preserving the final answer. This truncation strategy improved robustness under varying inference-time thinking budgets.
items.zh: 阶段3强化长上下文能力。它采用了与Nemotron-H准备过程中相同的长上下文数据配方，以及跨领域的增强示例，这些示例中推理痕迹被截断至1–2k令牌，同时保留最终答案。这种截断策略提高了在推理时思考预算变化下的鲁棒性。

items.en: To improve instruction adherence, we sampled 16,000 prompts from the LMSYS Chat dataset and augmented them with IFEval-style instructions. A rule-based verifier scored outputs based on how well they satisfied each instruction, creating a reward signal that prioritized following directions with precision. IFEval RL experiments provided significant boost to IFEval capabilities while the rest of the benchmarks fluctuated slightly requiring careful checkpoint selection.
items.zh: 为了改进指令遵循，我们从LMSYS Chat数据集中采样了16,000条提示，并使用IFEval风格的指令进行增强。一个基于规则的验证器根据输出满足每条指令的程度进行评分，从而产生一个优先强调精确遵循指令的奖励信号。IFEval强化学习实验显著提升了IFEval能力，而其他基准略有波动，需要仔细选择检查点。

items.en: In another branch of training, we apply the DPO algorithm to improve tool-calling. We evaluate performance using the BFCL v3 benchmark, which extends BFCL v2 with greater emphasis on multi-step (multiple tool calls to achieve a goal) and multi-turn (multiple user–agent interactions). To strengthen these capabilities in the Nano V2 aligned model, we use the WorkBench environment, a multi-step verifiable tool-calling setup adapted from Styles. In each WorkBench task, the model must issue a sequence of tool calls across multiple steps, with correctness verified through database state comparisons.
items.zh: 在另一个训练分支中，我们应用DPO算法来改进工具调用。我们使用BFCL v3基准评估性能，该基准在BFCL v2基础上更强调多步（多次工具调用以实现一个目标）和多轮（多次用户-智能体交互）。为了在Nano V2对齐模型中增强这些能力，我们使用了WorkBench环境，这是一个从Styles改编的多步可验证工具调用设置。在每个WorkBench任务中，模型必须在多个步骤中发出一系列工具调用，并通过数据库状态比较验证正确性。

items.en: Nano V2 undergoes reinforcement learning in this environment through iterative stages of Direct Preference Optimization. For each candidate checkpoint from the long-context stage, we generate on-policy data consisting of positive examples (successful tool calls) and negative examples (failed generations) for every WorkBench prompt. This process ensures that iterative DPO remains on-policy.
items.zh: Nano V2 在此环境中通过迭代阶段的直接偏好优化进行强化学习。对于来自长上下文阶段的每个候选检查点，我们为每个 WorkBench 提示生成在策略数据，包括正例（成功的工具调用）和负例（失败的生成）。这一过程确保迭代 DPO 保持在策略上。

items.en: We evaluate the model’s overall helpfulness and chat capabilities using the Arena-Hard benchmark. To improve performance on this benchmark, we use GRPO to train candidate checkpoints from the SFT stage using English-only contexts from HelpSteer3. During training, we generate responses both with and without thinking traces and use a Qwen-based reward model to judge the rollouts.
items.zh: 我们使用 Arena-Hard 基准评估模型的整体有帮助性和聊天能力。为提升在该基准上的性能，我们使用 GRPO 从 SFT 阶段训练候选检查点，仅使用 HelpSteer3 中的英文上下文。训练期间，我们生成带或不带思考轨迹的响应，并使用基于 Qwen 的奖励模型评判生成结果。

items.en: During training, we observed a trade-off between reasoning capabilities and chat capabilities. To address this, we opted for checkpoint interpolation, blending in an RL checkpoint with strong reasoning capabilities with an RL checkpoint with strong chat capabilities. Checkpoint interpolation is performed by linearly interpolating model weights: ⟀( (1-⟀alpha) ⟀cdot w_{model1} + ⟀alpha ⟀cdot w_{model2} ⟀). We experimented with a parameter sweep over ⟀alpha values from 0.1 to 0.9 in increments of 0.1, and found that values around 0.5 offered a good trade-off.
items.zh: 在训练过程中，我们观察到推理能力与聊天能力之间的权衡。为解决此问题，我们选择了检查点插值，将具有强推理能力的 RL 检查点与具有强聊天能力的 RL 检查点混合。检查点插值通过对模型权重进行线性插值实现：⟀( (1-⟀alpha) ⟀cdot w_{model1} + ⟀alpha ⟀cdot w_{model2} ⟀)。我们对 ⟀alpha 从 0.1 到 0.9 以 0.1 为步长进行了参数扫描，发现约 0.5 的值提供了良好的权衡。

items.en: Our 12B model’s performance is summarized in Table 8. To test reasoning capabilities across domains, we evaluate the models on MATH-500, AIME-2024, AIME-2025, GPQA-Diamond, LiveCodeBench (07/24 - 12/24), SciCode, and Humanity’s Last Exam. For broader evaluation on diverse capabilities, we use IFEval for instruction following capabilities, BFCL v3 for tool-calling, RULER for long-context, and ArenaHard for chat capability.
items.zh: 我们的12B模型性能汇总于表8。为测试跨领域的推理能力，我们在MATH-500、AIME-2024、AIME-2025、GPQA-Diamond、LiveCodeBench（2024年7月至2024年12月）、SciCode和Humanity’s Last Exam上评估模型。为更广泛地评估多样化能力，我们使用IFEval评估指令遵循能力、BFCL v3评估工具调用、RULER评估长上下文、ArenaHard评估聊天能力。

items.en: We conduct evaluations using NeMo-Skills (https://github.com/NVIDIA/NeMo-Skills). We report Pass@1 average of 16 runs for AIME-2024, AIME-2025; average of 4 runs for MATH-500, GPQA-Diamond, LiveCodeBench, IFEval; and score of 1 run for BFCL v3, SciCode, Humanity’s Last Exam, RULER, and ArenaHard.
items.zh: 我们使用NeMo-Skills（https://github.com/NVIDIA/NeMo-Skills）进行评估。我们报告AIME-2024和AIME-2025的Pass@1平均值为16次运行；MATH-500、GPQA-Diamond、LiveCodeBench、IFEval的平均值为4次运行；BFCL v3、SciCode、Humanity’s Last Exam、RULER和ArenaHard为1次运行得分。

items.en: Nemotron Nano V2 allows users to specify how many thinking tokens the model may generate before producing the final answer. The final answer is the portion of text typically shown to end users. This feature is implemented by counting tokens after the model begins generating the <think> token. Once the budget is reached, the inference setup attempts to insert a closing </think> tag. Rather than inserting it immediately, we let the model finish its current sentence and place the tag at the next newline. In extreme cases where no newline appears, the system enforces closure within 500 tokens past the budget: if no newline occurs by the \(\text{budget}+500\) th token, the </think> tag is forcibly inserted.
items.zh: Nemotron Nano V2 允许用户指定模型在生成最终答案之前可以生成多少个思考词元。最终答案通常显示给最终用户的部分文本。该功能通过统计模型开始生成 <think> 词元后的词元数量来实现。一旦达到预算，推理设置会尝试插入闭合的 </think> 标签。我们不会立即插入，而是让模型完成当前句子，并在下一个换行处放置标签。在极端情况下，如果没有换行，系统会在超出预算的500个词元内强制闭合：如果到第 \(\text{budget}+500\) 个词元仍未出现换行，则强制插入 </think> 标签。

items.en: In one failure mode, the model uses more tokens in the final answer to “compensate” for restrictions in the thinking traces. Without truncated training examples in the SFT stage, this compensation effect is prevalent (Figure 5(a), center). With truncated training, however, the effect is absent (Figure 5(b), center).
items.zh: 在一种故障模式中，模型在最终答案中使用更多词元来“补偿”思考轨迹中的限制。如果没有在 SFT 阶段使用截断训练样本，这种补偿效应很普遍（图 5(a)，中间）。然而，使用截断训练后，该效应消失（图 5(b)，中间）。

items.en: Another issue is that the model can remain in “thinking mode” even after the closing tag </think> is inserted. This is evident when the model generates the closing tag again after the forced insertion, suggesting it does not fully “register” the artificial closure. We evaluate this using “Well-Formedness,” where a well-formed response should contain only a single closing tag (either forced by the budget or produced naturally). Figure 5(a) (right) shows that for short budgets, the percentage of well-formed responses drops sharply. With truncation training, however, the model consistently produces well-formed responses (Figure 5(b), right).
items.zh: 另一个问题是，即使在插入闭合标签 </think> 之后，模型可能仍处于“思考模式”。当模型在强制插入后再次生成闭合标签时，这一点很明显，表明它并未完全“注册”人工闭合。我们使用“格式良好性”（Well-Formedness）来评估这一点，其中格式良好的响应应仅包含一个闭合标签（由预算强制或自然生成）。图 5(a)（右）显示，对于短预算，格式良好响应的百分比急剧下降。然而，使用截断训练后，模型一致地生成格式良好的响应（图 5(b)，右）。

items.en: In this section, we describe the pruning and distillation process to compress the aligned 12B model to the Nano 2 model with the goal of running longer context (128k sequence length) inference on the NVIDIA A10G GPU. Note that storing just the weights of a 12B parameter model in bfloat16 precision requires 22.9 GiB, which is more than the 22 GiB memory capacity of an A10G GPU; this clearly indicates the need for compression.
items.zh: 在本节中，我们描述剪枝与蒸馏过程，将经过对齐的12B模型压缩为Nano 2模型，目标是在NVIDIA A10G GPU上运行更长上下文（128k序列长度）的推理。注意，仅以bfloat16精度存储12B参数模型的权重就需要22.9 GiB，这已超过A10G GPU的22 GiB内存容量；这明确表明了压缩的必要性。

items.en: Our compression strategy builds on Minitron, which is a lightweight model pruning framework for LLMs. While Minitron was originally designed for compressing pretrained base models targeting user-defined parameter budgets, in this work, we extend it to compress reasoning models while also incorporating the memory constraints and throughput-based objectives stated above.
items.zh: 我们的压缩策略基于Minitron，这是一个用于大语言模型的轻量级模型剪枝框架。虽然Minitron最初设计用于压缩预训练基础模型，以满足用户定义的参数量预算，但在本工作中，我们将其扩展以压缩推理模型，同时纳入上述的内存约束和基于吞吐量的目标。

items.en: We collect importance or sensitivity scores for each model component (e.g., layers, FFN neurons) to help decide which components to remove; this is the importance estimation phase. The scores computed in this phase are used to decide which model components can be pruned. We note that sensitivity analysis based on gradient information is typically impractical at modern LLM scale; instead, we rely on a lightweight strategy that uses only forward passes. In this work, we use a simplified approach that works well in our ablation studies: a) prune layers, and b) prune FFN hidden dimensions (effectively neurons) and embedding channels. We also experimented with pruning Mamba heads; unfortunately, this axis caused severe accuracy degradation. We now describe how we compute the importance of each layer, embedding channel, FFN neuron, and Mamba head.
items.zh: 我们收集每个模型组件（如层、FFN神经元）的重要性或敏感性分数，以帮助决定移除哪些组件；这就是重要性估计阶段。在该阶段计算的分数用于决定哪些模型组件可以被剪枝。我们注意到，基于梯度信息的敏感性分析在现代大语言模型规模下通常不实用；相反，我们依赖一种仅使用前向传播的轻量级策略。在本工作中，我们采用了一种在我们的消融研究中表现良好的简化方法：a) 剪枝层，b) 剪枝FFN隐藏维度（即神经元）和嵌入通道。我们还尝试了剪枝Mamba头；不幸的是，这一维度导致了严重的准确率下降。现在我们描述如何计算每层、每个嵌入通道、每个FFN神经元和每个Mamba头的重要性。

items.en: We compute layer importance in an iterative fashion: for each candidate layer, we temporarily remove it from the model and compute the mean squared error (MSE) between the original model's logits and those produced by the pruned model. This MSE reflects the contribution of that layer to the model's predictions: lower values indicate smaller impact. At each pruning step, we remove the layer with the lowest MSE, as it has the least influence on the final output. We repeat this process until the desired depth is reached. This strategy ensures that pruning preferentially removes layers whose absence minimally affects the model's behavior. For more details on iterative MSE-based layer importance, please refer to .
items.zh: 我们以迭代方式计算层重要性：对于每个候选层，我们将其临时从模型中移除，并计算原始模型logits与剪枝模型logits之间的均方误差（MSE）。该MSE反映了该层对模型预测的贡献：值越小表示影响越小。在每个剪枝步骤中，我们移除具有最小MSE的层，因为它对最终输出的影响最小。我们重复此过程，直到达到所需的深度。这一策略确保剪枝优先移除那些缺失对模型行为影响最小的层。关于基于迭代MSE的层重要性的更多细节，请参考。

items.en: Here, \(\mathbf{X}\) denotes the input, and \(\boldsymbol{W}_{1}\) and \(\boldsymbol{W}_{2}\) are the two associated weight matrices in the FFN layer. \(\boldsymbol{W}_{1},\boldsymbol{W}_{2}\in\mathbb{R}^{d_{ffn}\times d_{model}}\) , where \(d_{model}\) and \(d_{ffn}\) are the model hidden dimension and FFN hidden dimension respectively. \(\delta(\cdot)\) refers to the non-linear activation function (squared ReLU in this work).
items.zh: 这里，\(\mathbf{X}\) 表示输入，\(\boldsymbol{W}_{1}\) 和 \(\boldsymbol{W}_{2}\) 是FFN层中两个相关的权重矩阵。\(\boldsymbol{W}_{1},\boldsymbol{W}_{2}\in\mathbb{R}^{d_{ffn}\times d_{model}}\)，其中 \(d_{model}\) 和 \(d_{ffn}\) 分别是模型隐藏维度和FFN隐藏维度。\(\delta(\cdot)\) 表示非线性激活函数（本工作中使用平方ReLU）。

items.en: Following the same procedure as Minitron , we compute the importance of each neuron in the first linear operator of each FFN layer by examining the set of outputs it produces. We use a small calibration dataset of 1024 samples for this purpose. Formally, we compute each neuron's importance score by aggregating its outputs given an input batch \(X\) :

items.en: Here, \(\boldsymbol{W}_{1}^{i}\) refers to the \(i^{\text{th}}\) row of the weight matrix \(\boldsymbol{W_{1}}\). \(\sum_{\mathbf{B,S}}\) refers to aggregation along the batch and sequence dimensions. We use the mean and l2-norm aggregation functions along the batch and sequence dimensions, following the observations in the Minitron paper. For a sequence of scores \(\mathbf{S}\), mean aggregation is defined as \(\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}|\mathbf{S}_{i}|\), and l2-norm is \(\sqrt{\sum_{i=1}^{n}\mathbf{S}_{i}^{2}}\). Embedding channel importance is computed similarly, by examining the outputs of LayerNorm layers instead; we refer the reader to for more details.
items.zh: 这里，\(\boldsymbol{W}_{1}^{i}\) 指权重矩阵 \(\boldsymbol{W_{1}}\) 的第 \(i\) 行。\(\sum_{\mathbf{B,S}}\) 指对批次维度和序列维度进行聚合。我们遵循 Minitron 论文中的观察，沿批次维度和序列维度使用均值和 l2-范数聚合函数。对于得分序列 \(\mathbf{S}\)，均值聚合定义为 \(\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}|\mathbf{S}_{i}|\)，l2-范数为 \(\sqrt{\sum_{i=1}^{n}\mathbf{S}_{i}^{2}}\)。嵌入通道重要性的计算类似，但通过检查 LayerNorm 层的输出；详情请读者参阅。

items.zh: 并且每个 Mamba 组 \(\mathcal{G}_{g}\) 内的头被排序，以保持组感知计算语义：

items.en: which ensures that pruning decisions respect the model’s structural constraints and SSM’s sequence modeling. The lowest-scoring heads are pruned by trimming the corresponding rows from all affected projection, convolution, and SSM parameter matrices. This strategy preserves the integrity of the SSM block while removing less important Mamba heads. As shown in , pruning Mamba heads yields a better accuracy–throughput trade-off than pruning head channels; we consequently focus on head pruning in this work.
items.zh: 这确保了剪枝决策尊重模型的结构约束和 SSM 的序列建模。得分最低的头通过从所有受影响的投影、卷积和 SSM 参数矩阵中裁剪相应行来剪除。该策略在移除较不重要的 Mamba 头的同时保留了 SSM 块的完整性。如所示，剪枝 Mamba 头比剪枝头通道能带来更好的准确率-吞吐量权衡；因此我们在本工作中专注于头剪枝。

items.en: We first define the constraints and objectives for the Nano 2 model, and then describe our lightweight Neural Architecture Search (NAS) framework that finds the most promising architectural candidates that meet our objectives and constraints.
items.zh: 我们首先定义Nano 2模型的约束和目标，然后描述我们的轻量级神经架构搜索（NAS）框架，该框架寻找最符合我们目标和约束的架构候选。

items.en: Memory requirements during inference consist of two distinct components with different scaling behaviors. The parameter memory, while substantial, remains constant regardless of the input size. In contrast, the key-value cache memory scales linearly with both batch size and sequence length, often becoming the dominant factor in long-sequence scenarios. For the Nano 2 model, our goal was to be able to perform inference at a sequence length of 128k and a batch size of at least 1 within a memory budget of 19.66 GiB. We obtained the budget as follows: from the 22.06 GiB available memory on an NVIDIA A10G GPU, we subtract a 5% buffer for frameworks such as vLLM and TensorRT-LLM and another 1.3 GiB to allow sufficient space for a vision encoder.
items.zh: 推理过程中的内存需求由两个具有不同缩放行为的不同组件组成。参数内存虽然庞大，但无论输入大小如何保持不变。相反，键值缓存内存随批量大小和序列长度线性扩展，在长序列场景中通常成为主导因素。对于Nano 2模型，我们的目标是能够在序列长度为128k且批量大小至少为1的情况下，在19.66 GiB的内存预算内进行推理。我们如下获得预算：从NVIDIA A10G GPU上22.06 GiB的可用内存中，减去5%的缓冲用于vLLM和TensorRT-LLM等框架，再减去1.3 GiB以留出足够空间给视觉编码器。

items.en: For the experiments below, unless otherwise specified, we measure throughput on an input and output sequence length of 8k and 16k tokens respectively, which we believe represents a typical reasoning scenario. For this combination of input and output sequence length, we report vLLM output token generation throughput at the maximum batch size that fits on the A10G GPU.
items.zh: 对于以下实验，除非另有说明，我们分别在输入和输出序列长度为8k和16k个token时测量吞吐量，我们认为这代表典型的推理场景。对于这种输入和输出序列长度组合，我们报告在A10G GPU上适配的最大批量大小下的vLLM输出token生成吞吐量。

items.en: Our compression strategy explores multiple axes within the 19.66 GiB memory budget through combinatorial pruning. Our search space includes depth reduction (removing 6-10 layers from the original 62-layer architecture) combined with width pruning of embedding channels (4480-5120), FFN dimension (13440-20480), and Mamba heads (112-128). This multi-axis search space results in hundreds of candidate architectures meeting the memory constraint.
items.zh: 我们的压缩策略在19.66 GiB内存预算内通过组合剪枝探索多个维度。搜索空间包括深度缩减（从原始62层架构中移除6-10层）与嵌入通道（4480-5120）、FFN维度（13440-20480）和Mamba头（112-128）的宽度剪枝相结合。这种多轴搜索空间产生了数百个满足内存约束的候选架构。

items.en: Since performing knowledge distillation and throughput benchmarking on the full set of candidates would be prohibitively expensive, we break down the problem into two parts: (1) find the optimal depth for the compressed model, and (2) find the optimal width-pruned architecture given the depth.
items.zh: 由于对所有候选架构进行知识蒸馏和吞吐量基准测试的成本过高，我们将问题分解为两部分：（1）寻找压缩模型的最优深度，（2）在给定深度下寻找最优宽度剪枝架构。

items.en: We compare the accuracy of three depth-pruned candidates obtained from the 12B model with 52, 54 and 56 layers. Here, we keep the number of attention layers fixed at 4 for all three variants so as to achieve a good balance between KV cache size and long-context performance; prior work has indicated that an attention-to-total-layers ratio between 7-8% is reasonable. We leave the width dimensions untouched for this experiment. Table 9 lists average reasoning accuracy at different depths after 6B tokens of distillation; in line with our previous observations on the strong correlation between depth and task performance, we notice that reducing depth beyond 56 layers results in significant accuracy degradation; as a result, we fix the depth at 56 for further width pruning.
items.zh: 我们比较了从12B模型获得的三个深度剪枝候选（层数分别为52、54和56）的准确率。这里，我们对所有三个变体保持注意力层数为4，以在KV缓存大小和长上下文性能之间取得良好平衡；先前工作表明，注意力层与总层数的比例在7-8%之间是合理的。此实验中我们保持宽度维度不变。表9列出了经过6B词元蒸馏后不同深度的平均推理准确率；与我们之前关于深度与任务性能强相关的观察一致，我们发现将深度减少到56层以下会导致显著的准确率下降；因此，我们将深度固定为56层以进行进一步的宽度剪枝。

items.en: As described above, we fix the depth of our target model to 56 layers with 4 attention layers. We perform 60B tokens of distillation on this checkpoint (see Section 4.3 for additional details) and perform further width pruning along the embedding, FFN, and Mamba axes. We enumerate all candidate pruned architectures that meet our memory budget, and sort them in decreasing order of estimated memory consumption at 128k context length and batch size 1. The top 3 candidates from this list are picked for further evaluation: in particular, we perform short Knowledge Distillation (KD) on these candidates for 19B tokens after depth+width pruning; we also benchmark throughput to pick the final architectural candidate. Table 10 lists the architectural details of the top 3 candidates, along with the achieved task performance (post KD) and throughput. As shown in the Table, Candidate 2 achieves the best accuracy while still having reasonable runtime performance; consequently, we use this architecture for Nano 2.
items.zh: 如上所述，我们将目标模型的深度固定为56层，其中包含4个注意力层。我们对该检查点进行60B词元的蒸馏（详见第4.3节），并沿着嵌入、FFN和Mamba轴进行进一步的宽度剪枝。我们枚举所有满足内存预算的候选剪枝架构，并按在128k上下文长度和批大小1下的估计内存消耗降序排列。从该列表中选出前3个候选进行进一步评估：具体地，我们在深度+宽度剪枝后对这些候选进行19B词元的短期知识蒸馏（KD）；同时我们基准测试吞吐量以选择最终架构候选。表10列出了前3个候选的架构细节，以及它们实现的任务性能（KD后）和吞吐量。如表所示，候选2在保持合理运行时性能的同时取得了最佳准确率；因此，我们采用该架构用于Nano 2。

items.en: We ablate the number of Mamba heads following the recipe in , considering configurations with 87.5% and 93.75% of the original heads. However, due to the relatively smaller compression ratios explored in this work (less than 15% after depth pruning) compared to those in (around 50%), we find that applying Mamba head pruning yields limited benefit, and in these cases, pruning only the FFN and embedding dimensions—after depth pruning—proves sufficient to achieve the desired compression while preserving accuracy. Candidates 1 and 2 in Table 10 highlight this difference.
items.zh: 我们按照中的方法消融Mamba头的数量，考虑了原始头数的87.5%和93.75%两种配置。然而，由于本工作中探索的压缩比（深度剪枝后小于15%）相比中的（约50%）较小，我们发现应用Mamba头剪枝带来的收益有限，在这些情况下，仅剪枝FFN和嵌入维度（在深度剪枝之后）就足以在保持准确率的同时达到所需的压缩。表10中的候选1和候选2凸显了这一差异。

items.en: To recover the accuracy lost due to pruning, the model undergoes continued training. Recent work has demonstrated that distilling knowledge from the original model to the pruned model outperforms conventional fine-tuning; we thus adopt logit-based distillation for continued training, employing forward KL divergence loss exclusively during the accuracy recovery phase (see §3 of the Minitron paper for more details on the distillation loss formulation). Building on the candidate selection process described in §4.2, we continue training Candidate 2 in an extended phase, as detailed below, to yield the final Nano 2 reasoning and base models.
items.zh: 为了恢复剪枝导致的精度损失，模型需进行继续训练。近期研究表明，从原始模型向剪枝模型蒸馏知识优于传统微调；因此我们在继续训练中采用基于logit的蒸馏，仅在精度恢复阶段使用前向KL散度损失（关于蒸馏损失公式的更多细节，请参阅Minitron论文第3节）。基于第4.2节所述的候选选择过程，我们延长了候选2的训练阶段，如下所述，以得到最终的Nano 2推理模型和基础模型。

items.en: The reasoning model is distilled in stages with increasing sequence lengths to strengthen extended reasoning and long-context capabilities; this is followed by targeted reinforcement learning (RL), preference optimization and model merging to retain desired behaviors and ensure robustness across diverse tasks. We now describe these various stages:
items.zh: 推理模型分阶段蒸馏，序列长度递增，以增强扩展推理和长上下文能力；随后进行针对性的强化学习（RL）、偏好优化和模型合并，以保持所需行为并确保跨不同任务的鲁棒性。下面描述这些阶段：

items.en: Depth pruning to 56 layers; Knowledge Distillation (KD) with \(\sim\) 60B tokens at 8,192 sequence length.
items.zh: 深度剪枝至56层；知识蒸馏（KD）使用约600亿token，序列长度8192。

items.en: Width pruning and KD with:
items.zh: 宽度剪枝和KD使用：

items.en: \(\sim\) 50B tokens at 8,192 sequence length.
items.zh: 约500亿token，序列长度8192。

items.en: \(\sim\) 25B tokens at 49,152 sequence length.
items.zh: 在大约25B个token、序列长度为49,152时进行。

items.en: \(\sim\) 1B tokens at 262,144 sequence length.
items.zh: 在大约1B个token、序列长度为262,144时进行。

items.en: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO).
items.zh: 直接偏好优化（DPO）。

items.en: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO).
items.zh: 组相对策略优化（GRPO）。

items.en: KD with \(\sim\) 0.4B tokens at 262,144 sequence length to recover post-RL drops.
items.zh: 使用KD在大约0.4B个token、序列长度为262,144时恢复后RL阶段的损失。

items.en: RLHF for alignment with human preferences.
items.zh: RLHF用于与人类偏好对齐。

items.en: Model merging between steps 5 and 6 via 0.5 linear interpolation.
items.zh: 通过0.5线性插值在步骤5和6之间进行模型合并。

items.en: More details on DPO, GRPO and RLHF can be found in Section 3. Figure 6 shows the effects of staged training on model accuracy across different reasoning benchmarks. Here, the \(x\)-axis represents the various stages (starting from Step 2 above), and the \(y\)-axis shows the scores obtained for the various benchmarks as training progresses. As shown in the Figure, DPO and GRPO are critical for enhancing function-calling (BFCL v3) and instruction-following (IFEval) capabilities, though the latter temporarily degrades multi-task understanding (MMLU-Pro), which is recovered in the next step (post-GRPO KD). Finally, RLHF enhances alignment with human preferences (Arena-Hard) but causes additional benchmark drops, which are then recovered through model merging.
items.zh: 关于DPO、GRPO和RLHF的更多细节见第3节。图6展示了分阶段训练对不同推理基准上模型准确率的影响。图中，\(x\)轴表示各个阶段（从上述步骤2开始），\(y\)轴显示随着训练进行各基准的得分。如图所示，DPO和GRPO对于增强函数调用（BFCL v3）和指令遵循（IFEval）能力至关重要，尽管后者会暂时降低多任务理解（MMLU-Pro）能力，该能力在下一步（后GRPO知识蒸馏）中得以恢复。最后，RLHF增强了与人类偏好的对齐（Arena-Hard），但导致额外的基准下降，这些下降随后通过模型合并得到恢复。

items.capEn: Figure 6: Task accuracy at different stages of the distillation pipeline for Nemotron Nano 2.

items.en: Dataset: We observe that a mix of 70% post-training stage 2 data (Section 3.2) and 30% pretraining (Section 2.2) data yields the highest accuracy (Table 11). For KD at sequence length 262,144, we use 100% stage 3 post-training data (Section 3.2).
items.zh: 数据集：我们观察到，70%的后训练阶段2数据（第3.2节）与30%的预训练数据（第2.2节）混合可获得最高准确率（表11）。对于序列长度为262,144的知识蒸馏，我们使用100%阶段3的后训练数据（第3.2节）。

items.en: Distillation proceeds in stages: depth-only pruning and KD on \(\sim\) 120B tokens, followed by width pruning and KD on \(\sim\) 360B tokens (both at sequence length 8,192), and finally KD on \(\sim\) 2.5B tokens at sequence length 524,288 to instill long-context capabilities.
items.zh: 蒸馏分阶段进行：在约120B词元上进行仅深度剪枝和知识蒸馏，随后在约360B词元上进行宽度剪枝和知识蒸馏（两者序列长度均为8,192），最后在约2.5B词元上进行序列长度为524,288的知识蒸馏，以灌输长上下文能力。

items.en: Dataset: Following [32], we use 100% pre-training data described in sections 2.2 and 2.6 for distillation of the base model at sequence lengths 8,192 and 524,288, respectively.
items.zh: 数据集：遵循[32]，我们分别使用第2.2节和第2.6节中描述的100%预训练数据，在序列长度为8,192和524,288的情况下对基础模型进行蒸馏。

items.en: We efficiently compress the 12B model to 9B parameters by pruning full layers (depth), FFN hidden size, and embedding channels, improving inference throughput and enabling long-context inference on an NVIDIA A10G GPU. Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2 retains 56 layers of the original model. Additionally, the number of embedding channels was pruned from 5120 to 4480, and FFN intermediate size was pruned from 20480 to 15680. As shown in Figure 1 and Tables 5 and 6, Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2 achieves 3\(\times\)-6\(\times\) higher throughput than Qwen3-8B for generation-heavy scenarios, while surpassing it in accuracy and remaining comparable to the 12B teacher on most benchmarks.
items.zh: 我们通过剪枝完整层（深度）、FFN隐藏大小和嵌入通道，高效地将12B模型压缩至9B参数，提升了推理吞吐量，并在NVIDIA A10G GPU上实现了长上下文推理。Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2保留了原始模型的56层。此外，嵌入通道数从5120剪枝至4480，FFN中间大小从20480剪枝至15680。如图1及表5、6所示，Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2在生成密集型场景中相比Qwen3-8B实现了3-6倍的更高吞吐量，同时在准确率上超越后者，并在大多数基准测试中与12B教师模型保持可比性。

items.en: In this report, we introduced Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2, a hybrid Mamba-Transformer reasoning model that achieves comparable or better accuracies at up to 6\(\times\) higher throughput than existing state-of-the-art models such as Qwen3-8B. To create Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2, we started by pre-training Nemotron-Nano-12B-v2-Base on 20T tokens, using a carefully constructed mix of curated and synthetically generated data. We aligned Nemotron-Nano-12B-v2-Base using several stages of SFT, GRPO, DPO, and RLHF before using the Minitron compression via pruning and distillation strategy to produce the final model. As a result of this compression, Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2 can run inference on context lengths of up to 128k tokens in bfloat16 precision on a single NVIDIA A10G GPU with 22 GiB of memory. We have open-sourced Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2 along with its corresponding sibling Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2-Base and parent Nemotron-Nano-12B-v2-Base models, plus the majority of its pre- and post-training data on HuggingFace (links at the bottom of Section 1).
items.zh: 在本报告中，我们介绍了 Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2，这是一种混合型 Mamba-Transformer 推理模型，在吞吐量比现有最先进模型（如 Qwen3-8B）高出多达 6 倍的情况下，仍能达到相当或更好的准确率。为了创建 Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2，我们首先在 20T 词元上预训练了 Nemotron-Nano-12B-v2-Base，使用了精心构建的精选数据和合成数据混合体。我们通过多阶段的 SFT、GRPO、DPO 和基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对 Nemotron-Nano-12B-v2-Base 进行对齐，然后使用 Minitron 压缩策略（通过剪枝和蒸馏）来生成最终模型。由于这种压缩，Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2 能够在单个具有 22 GiB 内存的 NVIDIA A10G GPU 上，以 bfloat16 精度对长达 128k 词元的上下文长度运行推理。我们已在 HuggingFace 上开源了 Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2 及其对应的兄弟模型 Nemotron-Nano-9B-v2-Base 和父模型 Nemotron-Nano-12B-v2-Base，以及大部分预训练和后训练数据（链接见第 1 节底部）。
